name: Chest
description: Presses the arm across the body; drives pushing movements like bench press and push-ups.

name: Back (Lats)
description: The broad back muscle that pulls the arm down and in; drives pull-ups and rows.

name: Upper Back
description: Retracts and stabilizes the shoulder blades; supports posture and pulling strength.

name: Shoulders
description: Caps the shoulder and lifts the arm in every direction; drives presses and raises.

name: Trapezius
description: Runs from the neck to mid-back; shrugs the shoulders and stabilizes the shoulder blades.

name: Biceps
description: Bends the elbow and rotates the forearm; drives curls and pulling movements.

name: Triceps
description: Straightens the elbow; drives pressing and pushdown movements.

name: Forearms
description: Controls the wrist and grip; built up by carries, curls, and grip work.

name: Abs
description: Flexes the spine; the 'six-pack' muscle worked by crunches and leg raises.

name: Obliques
description: Rotates and side-bends the torso; worked by twisting and anti-rotation exercises.

name: Glutes
description: The largest hip muscle; extends the hip and drives squats, deadlifts, and lunges.

name: Quads
description: Straightens the knee; the primary muscle group in squats, lunges, and leg press.

name: Hamstrings
description: Bends the knee and extends the hip; worked by deadlifts, leg curls, and sprints.

name: Calves
description: Points the foot downward; built up by calf raises and jumping/sprinting.
